sn55.9:1.1: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn55.9:2.1: asoko ānanda bhikkhu kālakato āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
sn55.9:3.1: ayaṃ kho so ānanda dhammādāso dhammapariyāyo
sn55.9:3.2: yena samannāgato ariyasāvako ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya
sn55.9:3.3: khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoniyo khīṇapittivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyanoti.
